args.sql:
WITH LatestAssessments AS (
    SELECT 
        patref, 
        abref, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patref ORDER BY timemark DESC) as rn
    FROM 
        encounters
),
HighPriorityPatients AS (
    SELECT 
        a.patref,
        MAX(b.suicrisk) AS max_suicrisk,
        MAX(b.violrisk) AS max_violrisk,
        MAX(b.subuse) AS max_subuse
    FROM 
        LatestAssessments a
    JOIN 
        assessmentsymptomsandrisk b ON a.abref = b.asrkey
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
    GROUP BY 
        a.patref
)
SELECT 
    p.patkey, 
    CASE 
        WHEN hp.max_suicrisk = 'Severe' OR hp.max_violrisk = 'High' OR hp.max_subuse = 'Multiple'
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS high_priority
INTO 
    patient_risk_status
FROM 
    patients p
LEFT JOIN 
    HighPriorityPatients hp ON p.patkey = hp.patref;
